description: This file defines classes and methods for managing prompt templates fetched from Arize Phoenix, integrating with LiteLLM's prompt management system. It includes functionality for loading, rendering, and compiling prompt templates, as well as handling prompt metadata and parameters.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from Arize Phoenix, including its ID, messages, metadata, and model info.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading, rendering, and parsing prompt templates from Arize Phoenix, supporting Mustache/Handlebars templating.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptManager
classes.description: Integrates Arize Phoenix prompt templates into LiteLLM's prompt management system, enabling prompt fetching, rendering, and pre-call processing.

methods.name: _load_prompt_from_arize
methods.description: Fetches a specific prompt version from Arize Phoenix and stores it.

methods.name: _parse_prompt_data
methods.description: Parses prompt data from Arize Phoenix, extracting messages and metadata.

methods.name: render_template
methods.description: Renders a stored prompt template with provided variables into formatted messages.

methods.name: get_prompt_template
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a prompt template with variables, returning messages and metadata.

methods.name: _compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Loads and renders a prompt, then compiles it into a PromptManagementClient structure.

methods.name: async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Asynchronous version of _compile_prompt_helper, delegates to sync method.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Provides a chat completion prompt, leveraging base class implementation.

methods.name: integration_name
methods.description: Returns the string 'arize' as the integration name.

methods.name: prompt_manager
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the prompt manager instance.

methods.name: get_prompt_template
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a prompt template with variables, returning messages and metadata.

methods.name: pre_call_hook
methods.description: Prepares messages and parameters before calling the LLM, injecting prompt templates.

methods.name: reload_prompts
methods.description: Reloads prompt templates from Arize Phoenix.

methods.name: should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Always returns True, indicating prompt management should run.

methods.name: _compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Loads, renders, and compiles a prompt into a PromptManagementClient.
